# SyncytialMeshModel

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A mesoscale control-field framework where neurons form a continuous syncytial mesh, enabling distributed field-based control of spiking dynamics. Provides a scalable abstraction for coordinating large-scale neuromorphic systems without centralized control, critical for in-network neural processing.
